featured.label: Demo · floor defended
featured.blurb: Paid its team in 3 evidence-backed tranches. After a panic sell, the treasury bought tokens back below their backing and burned them.

featured.label: Demo · holders said no
featured.blurb: Holders objected to the first tranche with quorum: the team got nothing and the treasury became a redemption pool.

featured.label: Demo · raised in a stablecoin
featured.blurb: Raised 100 tUSD, an SPL test stablecoin standing in for USDC. The treasury pays the team in tUSD.

featured.label: Demo · raised in a tokenized stock
featured.blurb: Raised in tNVDAx, a Token-2022 test token standing in for an xStock. The floor was defended in tNVDAx.

featured.label: Demo · Bedrock clause on-chain
featured.blurb: Taken over the only way the program allows: the acquirer paid every holder the on-chain TWAP +30%.

featured.label: Demo · the team went silent
featured.blurb: No tranche request inside the guard window, so anyone could hand the treasury back to holders.

featured.label: Live · budget + keeper
featured.blurb: The team draws a bounded budget as an advance on its next tranche; the public keeper settles tranches and records the TWAP every 10 minutes.
